title: Gorgon tracker score (hydrapy-tracker-1)
description: The score document exchanged between the tracker editor, HydraPy Studio and bridge followers such as the VCV Rack module. Normative reference: spec/score.md. Validation in the reference implementation: hydrapy/studio_tracker.py validate().

bpm.description: Quarter notes per minute. A row is a sixteenth.

key.description: Semitone of the key's root: C, D, F or G. Pitched notes are transposed by key - 2 (D is the reference key).

pattern.description: The selected pattern; the one that plays when loop is true.

loop.description: true: cycle the selected pattern (16 beats). false: cycle all four patterns in order (64 beats).

sound.description: Browser audition synth on/off. Editor state; followers ignore it.

mutes.description: One per audio lane. A muted lane sends no gates or hits and does not update its held pitch or velocity.

modes.description: Which Studio output each monitor shows. Program also selects Studio's displayed/recorded output.

bindings.description: The patch control each automation lane drives, by name. An empty string disconnects the lane. Non-empty names must be distinct.

note.description: C0-G9 with an optional separator or sharp: 'C-4' and 'C4' both mean MIDI 60; 'D#4' is MIDI 63. B# and E# are rejected, as is anything above G9 (MIDI 127). 'AIR' is an unpitched event: it opens a gate and updates velocity but leaves the held pitch unchanged.

vel.description: Velocity 0-127. Zero is silent: no gate, no hit, held values unchanged.

easing.description: Interpolation between automation keys: step at the key row, linear, or smoothstep (t*t*(3-2t)).

audio.description: Four audio lanes of 64 cells; null is an empty cell.

keys.description: Automation keys per lane, sorted by row with unique rows, at most 64 per lane. Lane ranges: z 0-1 (default 0.35), roll -45-45 degrees (default 0), feedback 0-0.9 (default 0.25).

name.description: A scene the patch declares. A name the patch does not declare is kept in the score and ignored when playing.

fade.description: Crossfade length in rows from the previous scene on the same output. Clipped to the gap before the next change.

scenes.description: Scene changes, sorted by row with unique rows. Optional: scores saved before scenes existed load unchanged. Visual side only; CV followers ignore this field.

x-notes: Unknown top-level and pattern-level keys are tolerated and preserved by the reference implementation (the shipped demo score carries 'version' and 'scene'); implementations must ignore keys they do not know.
Row ordering (sorted, unique) within keys and scenes cannot be expressed in JSON Schema; validate it in code.
Non-finite numbers (NaN, Infinity) are rejected everywhere a number is accepted.
